p: The image-processing program used by the Gaia Depth Grade script (install both). It is installed as bin/gaia-depth-grade-sidecar and its licences in doc/scripts/GaiaDepthGrade/. It is a self-contained program (Python with NumPy, SciPy, Astropy, photutils, astroquery and Pillow); no Python installation is needed.

Delivered by PixInsight's update system (earlier versions were downloaded by the script). It runs on any Linux that runs PixInsight with glibc 2.34 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Rocky/RHEL 9+).
